with l as (select l.link_id, a.issue_key ik, a.project_key pk, b.issue_key ok from model.issue_link l join model.issue a on a.issue_key=l.from_issue_key join model.issue b on b.issue_key=l.to_issue_key where a.project_key<>b.project_key),
e as (select link_id, from_issue_key k from model.issue_link where link_id in (select link_id from l) union select link_id, to_issue_key from model.issue_link where link_id in (select link_id from l)),
c as (select i.project_key id, count(distinct e.k) value from e join model.issue i on i.issue_key=e.k group by 1)
select * from c order by value desc

with l as (select l.link_id, l.from_issue_key f, l.to_issue_key t from model.issue_link l join model.issue a on a.issue_key=l.from_issue_key join model.issue b on b.issue_key=l.to_issue_key where a.project_key<>b.project_key),
top as (select project_key from model.issue where issue_key in (select f from l union select t from l) group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 5)
select distinct l.link_id, k.issue_key, i.project_key from l, lateral (values (l.f),(l.t)) k(issue_key) join model.issue i on i.issue_key=k.issue_key
where exists (select 1 from model.issue x where x.project_key in (select project_key from top) and x.issue_key in (l.f,l.t))
